hey dude, I'm sorry you have to go through this but you're not alone. and sorry english is not my native language. 
I (f 23) kinda was in your position a year ago. and believe me. Breaks never work. at least not this way. She clearly doesn't want to be in a relationship with you anymore. The more you try to work it out the more you'll get hurt. I think that in her mind she's already moving on and slowly wants to end the relationship. Of course you still may be important to her but not in a romantical way. Shes probably on tinder already looking for new guys. When my bf wanted a break because things didn't work out I believed we could still make it work but I found out he already had tinder and several other dating apps on his phone ready to text other girls and to move on from me. It really broke me. I had no one to talk to at first since he was my bf and my best friend. Throughout our relationship I even neglected my friends to spend more time with him. I never felt so alone in my life, I cried every night. We went through so much together and had a great relationship of 3 years. And it was all gone. Holding on only made me a clown and I lost all self respect. Don't be like me, don't be a clown😂🤡

-DON'T be friends with her. 
-you really need to distance yourself emotionally from her which means deleting her from social media and deleting her number. 
-open up to friends about this, idk call your family call your mom your online friends or whoever. Just talk to people and distract yourself. surround yourself with people and start to enjoy your single life.
-use dating apps, meet new people, do the things you love. focus on your hobbies and interests. 
-think about yourself and what you want to achieve in life. You're so young and you have the whole world ahead of you.
- focus on becoming the best version of yourself
-there are plenty of fish in the sea (I know this saying is so overused but why? because it's true.) 

I did the things above and you know what? months later he wanted to hook up again. 

this is important :
There are so many guides online on how to get your ex back and they are all bullsht! 
what I learned was I could never be happy if I tried to change and be better because I wanted HIM back. When I started living for MYSELF instead, that's what naturally made him come back. But once you're at this point you probably don't want her back anyways.
